metadata.title: NORTHWISE core_nm EIA Report Inventory – Post-Audit
metadata.description: Audited inventory of EIA reports proposed for core Northern Metropolis (core_nm) scope. Updated with verification decisions, evidence, and rationales.
metadata.audit_source: EPD EIA register + nm.gov.hk four-zones pages

reports.audit_rationale: Project title explicitly contains 'Northern Metropolis'. Approved in 2026 under the NM programme. Located within San Tin Technopole, which is listed on nm.gov.hk as part of the Innovation and Technology Zone. This is unambiguously a core NM project.
reports.project_title_en: Northern Metropolis Highway – San Tin Section
reports.project_title_zh: 北部都會區公路 – 新田段
reports.duplicate_or_overlap: None. Distinct from AEIAR-261/2024 (San Tin / Lok Ma Chau Development Node), which is the land development this highway serves.
reports.notes: Transport infrastructure explicitly conceived and named as a Northern Metropolis project.

reports.audit_rationale: Project title names 'Ngau Tam Mei Area'. Ngau Tam Mei New Development Area is explicitly listed on nm.gov.hk as part of the Innovation and Technology Zone. Approved 2025 under the NM programme. Unambiguously core NM.
reports.project_title_en: Development at Ngau Tam Mei Area
reports.nm_area: Ngau Tam Mei New Development Area
reports.nm_evidence_excerpt: Ngau Tam Mei New Development Area

reports.audit_rationale: Project is the 'Eastern Connection Road' for the Lok Ma Chau Loop. While located within the Loop area (which is on nm.gov.hk), the project itself is transport infrastructure (a road) rather than the core development. The core Loop development is AEIAR-176/2013. Under strict core_nm criteria, infrastructure projects that are not explicitly named as Northern Metropolis projects may be considered related_nm rather than core_nm. However, this road is explicitly part of the Loop development programme and approved in 2026 under NM. Requires human judgment.
reports.project_title_en: Development of the Loop – Eastern Connection Road
reports.project_title_zh: 落馬洲河套地區發展 – 東面連接道路
reports.duplicate_or_overlap: Overlaps in area with AEIAR-176/2013 (Development of Lok Ma Chau Loop) but is a distinct scope (road vs. development node). Not a duplicate record.
reports.notes: Borderline case: infrastructure within a core NM area but not the core development itself.

reports.audit_rationale: Project title names 'San Tin / Lok Ma Chau Development Node'. San Tin Technopole is explicitly listed on nm.gov.hk as part of the Innovation and Technology Zone. Approved 2024. Unambiguously core NM.
reports.project_title_en: San Tin / Lok Ma Chau Development Node
reports.duplicate_or_overlap: Related to AEIAR-276/2026 (Northern Metropolis Highway – San Tin Section), which serves this node, but is a separate scope (development vs. transport). Not a duplicate.

reports.audit_rationale: Project covers Kwu Tung North and Fanling North New Development Areas. Both are explicitly listed on nm.gov.hk as part of the Boundary Commerce and Industry Zone. Although approved in 2013 (pre-dating the Northern Metropolis concept announced in 2021), these NDAs are now formally incorporated into the NM plan. The 2026 Policy Address explicitly references 'all nine New Development Areas' as part of NM fruition. Spatially and politically, this is core NM.
reports.project_title_en: North East New Territories New Development Areas
reports.nm_area: Kwu Tung North / Fanling North New Development Area
reports.nm_evidence_excerpt: Kwu Tung North / Fanling North New Development Area
reports.duplicate_or_overlap: Single EIA report covers both Kwu Tung North and Fanling North NDAs together. No separate EIA reports found for each NDA individually. Counts as one report.
reports.notes: Historical project: approved 8 years before NM concept announced, but now formally part of NM.

reports.audit_rationale: Project is the 'Development of Lok Ma Chau Loop'. HSITP in the Loop is explicitly listed on nm.gov.hk as part of the Innovation and Technology Zone. Approved 2013 (pre-dating NM concept), but the Loop is now formally incorporated into NM. The project website (lmc.wellab.hk) and ongoing EM&A reports confirm active status. Core NM.
reports.project_title_en: Development of Lok Ma Chau Loop
reports.duplicate_or_overlap: Related to AEIAR-274/2026 (Loop Eastern Connection Road), which serves this development. Not a duplicate. Note: two study briefs existed (ESB-201/2008 and ESB-238/2011) but only one EIA report (AEIAR-176/2013).
reports.notes: Historical project: approved 8 years before NM concept announced, but now formally part of NM.

Approved 2016 (pre-dating NM concept), but now formally incorporated into NM. Core NM.

audit_limitations: EPD register entries were verified online on 2026-10-18. Future status changes (e.g. permit variations, new submissions) are not reflected.
Northern Metropolis area membership was verified against nm.gov.hk 'Four Zones' pages only. Official gazettes or statutory plans were not checked.
Project scope was assessed from titles and EPD project pages. Full EIA report text was not reviewed for each project.
The Northern Metropolis concept was announced in the 2021 Policy Address. Projects approved before 2021 are flagged as historical but remain verified based on current nm.gov.hk zoning.
No EIA register pages beyond page 33 were checked; the register had 324 reports total. Additional core_nm projects may exist that were not identified in the title-based scan.
